lines.text: I bow my knees before the Father, from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name.
I ask that out of the riches of His glory He strengthen you with power through His angels.
I ask that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, as you are rooted and grounded in love.
Together with all the saints, you will comprehend the length and width and height and depth of Christ's kingdom.
God is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, and glory is His in the church.
